info.title: Telegram Drive local REST API
info.description: Served by the desktop application on the loopback interface while the REST API is enabled in Settings. Every route except the health check and this document requires X-API-Key. Cold folder reads walk history once and retain the newest 50,000 files; larger folders return complete:false. Recent snapshots can be reused for 30 seconds; recently used folders catch up every 30 seconds. Verified own uploads request destination-only catch-up, and existing-ID mutations use targeted verification. External edits and deletions use a shared, bounded rotating audit (25 lookup batches per rolling minute); offline periods and FLOOD waits suspend detection. Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC. Routes that would expose plaintext refuse encrypted files.

parameters.description: Folder to read. Omit to read every folder. An empty value, `null`, `none` or `home` reads Saved Messages.

parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.description: Files per page.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on the file name.

parameters.description: Smallest size in bytes.

parameters.name: size_max
parameters.description: Largest size in bytes.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Include files created at or after this time. RFC 3339; a plain date and Unix seconds are also accepted.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Include files created at or before this time.

parameters.name: offset_id
parameters.description: Include only files whose identifier is lower than this one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated file fields to return.
